parts.text: I plan and run flights as a dispatcher, taking legal responsibility for deciding which drone flies and along which way, and I sign off a flight before it leaves. Several of us plan at the same time, often for the same busy sites and popular drones, and I can call off a flight. I want help finding out which of my drones could get to where a job starts, but our policy is that software never chooses a drone or a way for us.
